tools.name: trivago-accommodation-radius-search
tools.description: PREFERRED way to search hotels. Search live hotel and accommodation listings around coordinates — the center of a city, a neighborhood, a landmark, an address, or a venue — aggregated via trivago's metasearch of major booking sites. Returns the same, filterable results as trivago-accommodation-searc

tools.name: trivago-accommodation-search
tools.description: Search live hotel and accommodation listings by name or free text, aggregated via trivago's metasearch of major booking sites. Returns results with price, rating, amenities, and a link per property. Supports date range, guest/room configuration, and filters for star rating, guest rating, amenities,

tools.name: trivago-destination-price-trends
tools.description: Forecast monthly hotel price trends for a destination — average, minimum, and maximum nightly rate by star rating, across a date window. Use for planning questions like "when is the cheapest month to visit X" or "how do prices change through the year" — this is a forecasting tool, not a live-availab

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "trivago-accommodation-radius-search" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: PREFERRED way to search hotels. Search live hotel and accommodation listings around coordinates — the center of a city, a neighborhood, a landmark, an address, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "trivago-accommodation-radius-search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
